boundaries.rationale: Node 24.21.0 passed the local SSH library, API, MCP and native OpenSSH/tmux fixtures. Bun 1.4.2 passes the Node crypto Argon2 smoke but rejects the required node:test invocation under --test. The approved deployable contract is Node 24.18 or newer; repository packaging outside this boundary retains Bun. Native macOS/Windows and hosted results are pending. Canonical SSH lifecycle sources now belong to the independent SSH repository; this boundary qualifies the pinned Node artifact consumer.
boundaries.revisit: Reassess a Bun candidate when it preserves the declared test-runner, vault, lifecycle and upstream runtime contracts, or on a Node regression.

boundaries.rationale: Bun remains the accepted starting candidate for unchanged repository validator commands. Current local aggregate proof for the updated dependency graph uses Bun 1.4.2; the declared CI toolchain and cross-platform hosted results remain separate observations.
boundaries.revisit: Re-evaluate after a Bun runtime regression, a failing mandatory validator, or a changed upstream runtime contract.

boundaries.rationale: Bun 1.4.0 fails three fail-closed backup-root replacement fixtures before their temporary-directory boundary; Node.js 24.18.0 preserves the required security behavior.
boundaries.revisit: Re-test on a Bun release that changes filesystem replacement behavior or after an independently justified fixture-boundary change.

boundaries.rationale: Node.js --check provides the required syntax-only contract; Bun --check executes scripts. The parent validator and focused fixtures still execute under Bun.
boundaries.revisit: Re-test when Bun documents Node-compatible syntax-only checking.

boundaries.rationale: The Bun parent intentionally invokes Node.js children to verify explicit Node CLI, shebang, renderer, and executable-resolution compatibility.
boundaries.revisit: Revisit when the compatibility probes are removed or their explicit Node.js contract changes.

boundaries.rationale: Oxfmt 0.71.0 and Oxlint 1.86.0 pass the repository formatter and linter on Linux/WSL (2026-10-01). The commands retain their native execution boundary; hosted checks remain separate.
boundaries.revisit: Revisit if the installed Oxc entrypoints stop being native executables.

boundaries.rationale: pnpm owns workspace selection for the site build and selects the isolated shadcn-lint fixture package; each package script selects its qualified runtime explicitly.
boundaries.revisit: Revisit if persistent package or workspace ownership changes.

boundaries.rationale: On 2026-10-01, Astro 7.3.5 and its SEO validator completed the 46-page production build on Linux/WSL under Bun 1.4.2 and Node.js 24.21.0. The declared CI toolchain and hosted Pages require current hosted observation.
boundaries.revisit: Re-evaluate after a material Astro, Vite, adapter, or GitHub Pages runtime change.

boundaries.rationale: Current repository-owned automation installs the pinned Bun runtime and runs the same package-script winners; cross-platform hosted results remain authoritative as they arrive.
boundaries.revisit: Re-evaluate on a failed hosted lane or material GitHub runner/runtime change.

boundaries.rationale: Historical release verification executes scripts captured from the tagged contract; changing their runtime in place would weaken immutable evidence.
boundaries.revisit: Revisit only through a successor to the historical release-evidence contract.

boundaries.rationale: The repository requires pnpm's transient resolution and trust boundary for the pinned upstream skills CLI.
boundaries.revisit: Revisit when the upstream CLI or repository dependency-trust policy changes.

boundaries.rationale: This repository publishes skills, plugins, archives, and a static Astro site; it has no Bun server artifact in scope.
boundaries.revisit: Revisit if the repository adds a server deployable.

boundaries.rationale: The advisor is a dependency-free Python 3.10+ helper; current local offline fixtures ran on Python 3.14.7. Earlier native Codex inspection predates the current runtime and does not qualify its host integration. Bun launches the repository gate but does not execute Python. The minimum interpreter and other hosts remain unqualified.
boundaries.revisit: Requalify after Python compatibility, cache primitive or helper dependency changes. If Python is unavailable, report the missing prerequisite; do not install or substitute a runtime silently.

boundaries.rationale: Existing Draw.io and SVG validation helpers execute Python explicitly under JavaScript parent gates. This inventory records their existing runtime rather than changing it; local aggregate fixtures passed on Python 3.14.7.
boundaries.revisit: Re-evaluate when the visual validators change runtime or minimum Python requirements; missing Python fails the owning check.

boundaries.rationale: The existing SkillOpt setup validator explicitly launches Python helpers. This newly discovered inventory entry records source-level ownership only; it does not claim a new SkillOpt execution result.
boundaries.revisit: Requalify after setup-helper runtime changes; fail the owning check if Python is absent instead of silently choosing a different runtime.

boundaries.rationale: Dependency-free POSIX helpers require Python 3.10+. All 15 synthetic tests passed on Python 3.12 in the managed Linux environment. This is helper evidence, not native MCP, live curation or host-trigger qualification.
boundaries.revisit: Requalify when helper/runtime contracts change; report missing Python instead of silently installing another runtime.

boundaries.rationale: The approved helper requires Node 24.18+ on Linux/POSIX. The original 16-case hosted and direct-instance evidence remains historical evidence for 0.3.0. The 0.5.0 review-correction receipt records 46 current local Node cases on Node 24.22.0; hosted results are attached to the reviewed PR commit, and live host/collection activation is not inferred from fixtures. The Bun parent orchestrates Python and Node gates through pinned pnpm without substituting runtimes.
boundaries.revisit: Requalify after changes to the helper runtime or filesystem/transport contract. Report missing Node rather than substituting another runtime silently.

boundaries.rationale: Bun retains the parent repository commands. Explicit Node 24.22.0 children exercised the documented Node launcher and the existing Portless 0.15.8 Node contract on Linux/WSL: inherited Git selectors, isolated HTTPS/HTTP/WebSocket forwarding, negative controls and alias lifecycle. This is an explicit Node compatibility fixture, not a general fallback or a claim that Bun is incompatible. Hosted and native-platform observations remain separate.
boundaries.revisit: Requalify when the documented Node example, Portless version or fixture runtime contract changes. Missing Node fails this explicit qualification boundary without installation or silent runtime substitution.

boundaries.rationale: Node 24.22.0 passed all 14 black-box fixture tests on Linux/WSL. The fixture grader and its children use the Node --test CLI contract through process.execPath. Bun 1.4.2 invoked with --test rejects this suite with Cannot use test outside of the test runner. This evidence selects Node for this concrete validator only; Bun remains the parent repository orchestrator. Hosted and other-platform observations remain separate.
boundaries.revisit: Requalify when Bun supports the required Node test-runner invocation or the fixture CLI contract changes; report missing Node rather than silently substituting a runtime.
